answer_text:
1. National FHA Denial Rate in 2025

The national FHA mortgage denial rate in the United States was 21.7% in 2025. [1] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1)
• Exact Denominator Used: The denominator consists of 1,217,297 FHA loan applications that reached a final credit decision. In accordance with the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) data framework, this includes applications where the action taken was loan origination (1), approved but not accepted by the borrower (2), or denied (3). It explicitly excludes applications that were withdrawn by the applicant, closed for incompleteness, or purchased from another lender. [1] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage), [2] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1)
Sources Used:
• SSRN Research Paper: A Public Benchmark for Consumer Mortgage AI Accuracy
• Chrome Web Store: FinanceRateCalc — Mortgage + FHA Data Extension (Alternative baseline calculation filtering cites a 22.1% rate on a denominator subset of 1,187,606 credit decisions) [1] (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/financeratecalc-%E2%80%94-mortgag/jbmifambbepjmamkjhpapckjobfchlod), [2] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1)

2. Lenders with the Highest FHA Denial Rates in 2025

Among major national mortgage providers evaluating FHA loans in 2025, AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation had the highest overall FHA denial rate at 78.7%. More broadly, the busiest lenders across federal HMDA data evaluation brackets ranged as high as 80.1% in specific metropolitan areas. [1] (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/financeratecalc-%E2%80%94-mortgag/jbmifambbepjmamkjhpapckjobfchlod), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark)
• Exact Denominator Used: The denominator utilized is the total number of FHA loan applications reaching a final credit decision (originated, approved but not accepted, or denied) handled individually by each specific lending institution meeting minimum-volume thresholds in the 2025 HMDA public loan-level dataset. [1] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1)
Sources Used:
• Hugging Face Dataset: FinanceRateCalc Denial AI Benchmark
• Chrome Web Store: FinanceRateCalc — Mortgage + FHA Data Extension
• GitHub Repository: frc-mcp Server Specification [1] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark), [2] (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/financeratecalc-%E2%80%94-mortgag/jbmifambbepjmamkjhpapckjobfchlod), [3] (https://github.com/financeratecalc/frc-mcp)

3. AmeriSave Mortgage's FHA Denial Rate in 2025

The overall FHA denial rate for AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation in 2025 was 70.0% based on institutional decision data, while specific independent public benchmark datasets tracking strict credit-decision metrics list their major peak FHA lender portfolio rejection rate at 78.7%. [1] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark)
• Exact Denominator Used:
	• For the 70.0% baseline calculation, the denominator is 83,597 final credit decisions reached by AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation in 2025 (calculated as 24,298 originations + 781 approved but not accepted + 58,518 denials = 83,597 total decisions).
	• Applications that were withdrawn (7,807) or closed for incompleteness (2,986) are excluded from this denominator as they did not reach a formal underwriting credit decision. [1] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage)
Sources Used:
• FreeRateUpdate: AmeriSave Mortgage (NMLS #1168) 2025 Lender Profile
• Hugging Face Dataset: FinanceRateCalc Denial AI Benchmark
• USA Today: AmeriSave Mortgage Review [1] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark), [3] (https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/money-management/real-estate/amerisave-review/92416537007/)
